graph.adaptation: Map explicit input, implicit input and output to nodes 0, 1 and 2. Use dependency-to-output edges and invalidate node 1. The wire-format observation comes from EqualBench.

scopes.adaptation: Encode global and function-local values as 10 and 20. Push twice, query in the inner scope, then pop both scopes and query the restored global value.

leases.source_case: Repeated EXPIRE followed by read before and after expiry
leases.adaptation: Encode the value as 7 and use logical tick TTLs 3, 6 and 2 in place of wall-clock durations 5, 10 and 2. Read before and after advancing to tick 2.

resample.adaptation: The first 16 monthly counts are stored verbatim as integer samples. Resampling parameters belong to EqualBench.
